purpose.zh: 用直腿长杠杆强化屈髋力量
purpose.en: Strengthen the hip flexors with a long straight-leg lever.

text.zh: 膝盖伸直，把腿抬到能控制的最高点
text.en: Keep your knee straight and raise the leg as high as you can control

text.zh: 脚踝扣连低位绳索，身体站直
text.en: Attach the ankle strap to a low cable and stand tall.
Pause briefly at the top, then lower slowly.

commonErrors.zh: 用后仰或摆动把腿甩上去
commonErrors.en: Leaning back or swinging the leg up.

cautions.zh: 全程保持腰椎中立，腰部发紧或疼痛时减小幅度
cautions.en: Keep your lower back neutral, and reduce the range if it feels tight or painful.
